title: Warlocks #5 Aircel Comics 1989 Horned Demon Cover Warlock 5 Spinoff Comic Book
conditionDescription: Covers bright with no tears. A few small spine ticks and a light bend at the lower left corner (see photo 2). Staples intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Warlocks #5 (1989), Aircel Comics - the Warlock 5 spinoff series, with a horned demon cover. Original $1.95 cover price ($2.50 in Canada).

Back cover: Eternity Comics "Four Hot Titles for 1989" ad (Robotech II, Ninja High School, War of the Worlds, Dinosaurs for Hire).

See photos for condition. Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
